6 flavour ideas shown

Vanilla bean

A delicate vanilla sponge with silky vanilla buttercream. Simple, soft and endlessly lovely.

Chocolate velvet

Rich chocolate sponge paired with smooth chocolate buttercream. A little indulgence in every bite.

Lemon & elderflower

Bright lemon sponge with a delicate elderflower-inspired finish. Light and beautifully fragrant.

Raspberry & white chocolate

A gentle balance of tart raspberry and creamy white chocolate sweetness.

Rose & pistachio

Soft floral notes and the mellow, nutty character of pistachio. A romantic pairing.

Salted caramel

Warm caramel sweetness with a subtle salty finish. Comforting, rich and celebratory.
